body:
## What it does

A coding assistant scoped to one framework: it produces and reviews Helidon 4 applications in both the SE and MP styles, running on Java 21 and later. It keeps a project to a single programming model and stays away from the older Helidon 3 APIs entirely. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @TheSurenk shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
